statement.zh: 通论/调查（Lehner；Edwards；Shaw 古王国章）将古王国王室纪念性陵墓——自萨卡拉阶梯金字塔至吉萨金字塔——表述为国家能力与王室意识形态表达的集中体现。
statement.en: Surveys (Lehner; Edwards; Shaw Old Kingdom chapter) frame Old Kingdom royal monumental tombs—from Saqqara Step Pyramid through the Giza pyramids—as concentrations of state capacity and royal ideology expressions.
